en.title: Muslim Marriage Registration in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: A Muslim marriage should be properly recorded through the lawful Nikah Registrar system. Keep the kabinnama and any certified copy safely. Registration creates an official record and helps prove important terms such as the parties, date and dower.

en.lawMeaning: The registration law gives Nikah Registrars duties relating to registration of Muslim marriages and divorces. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Check both parties’ names, age and identity details.
Collect and keep the kabinnama/certified copy.
Correct errors through the proper process.
evidence: NID/birth records as required; photographs if required; witness details; kabinnama; registrar receipt/copy.
en.simpleExample: A couple notices the bride’s name is misspelled on the kabinnama. They should use the proper correction process instead of relying on an informal handwritten change.
